text: Caitlin's pregnant!! Due early March. She told me over coffee, hasn't told her boss yet. Remind me to get her something small for the bump sometime next week
vet tues at 10:15 for the cat's jabs, take the carrier out of the loft tonight

bumped into Kofi at the park with his new puppy, a cockapoo called Pudding. He's not sleeping, puppy cries all night apparently. His girlfriend Ruby wanted a cat but lost the vote. They're doing puppy training on Saturday mornings and he asked if I'd come along one week with mine. Pudding's first vet check is next Wednesday at half 4, he's a bit worried she's got a limp
Ruby - christening on Sunday the 14th at 11am, St Mary's, lunch at her mum's after. Baby's name is Isla. Bring something white?

so I was talking to Ahmed and um his wife Sana had the baby on Tuesday night a little boy called Yusuf eight pounds two everyone's fine but Ahmed sounds absolutely shattered I need to drop round some food for them sometime this week maybe Thursday evening
Bogdan's dog Max has been off his food since the weekend, taking him to the vet Friday morning. He's really worried, Max is 13.

Sophie said her sister Fern is expecting twins!! Due end of the summer. Fern's pretty anxious about it apparently, first pregnancy and they live miles from family. Her husband Bogdan works away a lot too, offshore, two weeks on two weeks off. Sophie's going to stay with her for a bit in the autumn. I should send Fern a message this weekend, just to say congrats and that I'm around if she wants to talk
Dentist Weds 3pm. Bank before then. Return the parcel to the post office by end of the month
Bilal hates cats lol, keep that in mind when he comes round
Gintaras rang - his cat Tigras went missing three days ago. He's put posters up everywhere. Don't forget to share his post on the local Facebook group tonight
Magda's baby shower is off, she's been put on bed rest. Text her tomorrow morning to see how she's doing
Lachlan and Niamh's little one turns one on the 22nd. Party at theirs at 2. Niamh says Oscar's obsessed with diggers so maybe a toy digger
Amir's new rescue greyhound arrives Saturday morning! Name is Shadow. He's been reading up on greyhounds for weeks
need to book the car MOT sometime early Nov, also renew home insurance before the 30th
Eilidh - 34 weeks now, finishing work end of next week. Wants to paint the nursery but can't do ladders. She mentioned she'd love a nursing chair

Coffee w Tomás. His partner Kavya's scan is Thursday at half 9, the 20 week one. They're not finding out the gender. Must message Tomás afterwards to see how it went. Also Kavya's off dairy at the moment and Tomás is doing all the cooking, which, from what I remember of his cooking, is brave. They've booked a babymoon in Lisbon sometime in late November before she can't fly
Adaeze's dog Bisi turned 5 today, she did a whole cake for her. Lol
Bao said his mum's coming over from Hanoi in early December to help with the baby. Baby due mid Jan. He's thrilled, his mum less so about the cold
Giulia mentioned her rabbit Nutella has an op on the 3rd at 8am, teeth something. She's dreading it. Remind me to ask Giulia how Nutella got on
me and Gareth are taking his kids to the farm park over half term, I'm driving
Hassan's wife had a little girl!! Born Sunday at 4am, Laila. Send congrats and sort a card from the team
Joanna is vegetarian and allergic to nuts, she's bringing her partner Rafael who doesn't eat pork
Petra's cat Bruno was put to sleep yesterday afternoon. She had him 16 years. Shes heartbroken. Should send her a card and maybe some flowers this week
Nikolai got a parrot?? An African grey called Boris. Apparently it already swears.

Errands sat: dry cleaning, pick up prescription, new hoover bags, birthday card for Mum. Gym Sunday morning. Then I want to finally sort the spare room before the end of the month, take the old desk to the tip, get the bed frame put together and see if the charity shop takes the lamp. Haircut sometime next week too, ideally Tuesday after work
leon's girlfriend is due in about three weeks, he's on paternity leave from the 1st. he's v nervous about the birth
Talked to Oisín after the christening on Sunday. Little Aoife slept through the whole thing. Oisín's mum did all the food, his brother Cian was godfather. Need to send him the photos I took
Rin's moving flat end of the month and the new place doesn't allow pets so her cat Mochi is going to her parents for now. She's gutted

Barbara (Mrs B next door) asked if I can feed her cat while she's away, the 8th to the 15th. Twice a day, keys under the plant pot. The cat's called Duchess, she's on special kidney food, half a pouch in the morning and the dry stuff at night. Barbara's off to Edinburgh for her granddaughter's christening, first great grandchild, she's thrilled. Text her a photo of Duchess every couple of days so she doesn't fret
Thabo - new job at the vets on Monday. Starts at 8. Loves it already, he's wanted to work with animals for years

So Caitlin, Cait, called again, she's had the 12 week scan and everything looks good. Due date moved to 2nd March. She's feeling much better now the sickness has stopped. She and Dan are going to tell his parents at Sunday lunch
Gotta remember to order the dog food before Thursday, we're down to the last bag
Uncle Kofi's 70th is on the 9th at 7pm, family dinner at the Indian on the high street. I'm doing the cake
Called Ruby re Isla's christening photos. She also said Isla's teething badly and nobody's slept. Bless. Check in with her end of the week
Ahmed asked me to be godparent to Yusuf! Ceremony is sometime in the spring, maybe April. Need to work out what a godparent actually does

Sophie's guinea pigs had babies, four of them. She's trying to find homes, asked if I know anyone. Ask Niamh, her kids have been on about getting a pet. Sophie wants them gone by the end of next month because her landlord doesn't know about the first two, let alone six. Also her old boy Peanut has a bad eye and she's taking him to the exotic vet on Thursday at 5
cleaner coming tmrw 10-12, hide the laundry pile lol
Gintaras update - Tigras came home!! Walked in like nothing happened. G is over the moon
Fern's baby shower is the Saturday after next, 1pm at Sophie's. Fern doesn't want any games. Sophie's doing a group present, I'll chip in
Magda's okay, doctor says rest till 36 weeks then they'll see. Her husband Tomek's doing everything. She's bored out of her mind and would love some books
Lachlan said Oscar's starting nursery in January, 3 mornings a week. Niamh's not ready lol
Amir rang, Shadow's settling in fine but is terrified of the hoover. Amir's taking him to puppy class Tuesday evenings at 7
Book flights for the summer before prices go up. Also sort passport renewal, it expires in May
Bilal's sister Hana had her baby last week, baby boy, 3 weeks early but both doing well. Bilal is an uncle for the first time and won't stop showing photos
Lunch with Kavya. Scan was fine, all normal! She's getting a lot of heartburn though and craving lemons constantly. She said Tomás has already bought a cot even though it's months away
vet called, Pepper's bloods are back fine. pick up her tablets friday after 4
Joanna's dog Rolo had puppies on Saturday night - six! She's keeping one. Remind me to ask Joanna if Rafael still wants one
Nothing much today. Walked into town, got the bits for the weekend.

So Hassan's back at work Monday after paternity leave and he says Laila's colic is awful, they're up every couple of hours, his wife's mum is staying with them for a bit to help, he looked properly exhausted at the school gates this morning. I should offer to do the school run for his eldest one day next week, maybe Wednesday
Petra says thank you for the flowers. Doing a bit better, talking about getting a kitten maybe in the new year but not yet
Leon texted - baby arrived Weds 6:40am!! Girl, Maya, 7lb 1oz. Mum and baby fine. Need to sort a gift and a card before we visit on Saturday afternoon
Rin's got a new hamster for her parents' place lol, called Dumpling. Mochi ignores it
Thabo said first week at the vets was hard, lots of early mornings and he's a bit overwhelmed but the team is lovely. Text him Friday evening to see how he's finding it
Batch cook Sunday. Pay window cleaner. Ring the council about the bins first thing Monday
Oisín's partner Dee is pregnant again! Due late spring. Aoife's not even one yet. They're over the moon but terrified

Bao - baby came early!! Born last night at 11pm, boy, Minh. 4 weeks early so he's in special care for a few days. Bao's okay but stressed. His mum's flight isn't till December so they're trying to move it. Don't forget to message him tomorrow and see if they need anything dropped round
Barbara's back. Cat's fine, ate everything lol. She brought me shortbread from Scotland
Giulia: Nutella's op went fine, home now eating normally. G relieved

Eilidh had the baby on the 2nd at 9pm! Little girl Rosa. Her mum's staying for the first fortnight. Visit sometime the week after next when things calm down, and take the nursing chair voucher we all chipped in for

Long chat with Adaeze tonight. Her sister Chioma is pregnant, finally, after three years of trying and two rounds of IVF, so everyone's being very careful and not telling the wider family until after the scan on the 18th at 2pm. Adaeze's going with her. She's also thinking about getting Bisi a friend, maybe a second dog over the summer. Remember to ask Adaeze how the scan went, and maybe look for a little something for Chioma for later on
